title: Contraction parameter times norm bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$ with $q\ne0$, let $\rho\ge0$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Suppose the uniform $q$-norm of $x\mapsto a+\rho bX(x)$ is at most the uniform $p$-norm of $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$ for every pair of real numbers $a,b$. Then $\rho$ times the uniform $q$-norm of $X$ is at most its uniform $p$-norm.
hypotheses_covered: The defining hypercontractive inequality holds for all real $a,b$
